title: Check Claude CLI availability
responsibility: Checks the installed Claude CLI and subscription sign-in, then reports the configured model choice.

inputs.name: claudeState.command
inputs.description: The Claude CLI executable (command) and its initial arguments (args), which claudeState reads and never changes. It matters on every discovery call because claudeState appends '--version' and then 'auth status --json' to args and runs each with a ten-second timeout; a launch failure is returned as the reason rather than thrown.

outputs.name: claudeState
outputs.description: The resolved ProviderState that ClaudeCliAdapter.discover returns unchanged, with id 'claude', imageGeneration always false, and version set to the trimmed --version output whenever that call succeeds, even if sign-in later fails. A logged-in claude.ai subscription gives available true with the fixed Claude Opus 5.5 model (efforts low through max, with xhigh as default); any failure gives available false, an empty models list, and reason set to the error message, or 'Claude CLI unavailable.' for a non-Error value.

examples.label: Claude CLI
examples.reason: Sign in to Claude CLI with a subscription.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown inside claudeState, with the message 'Sign in to Claude CLI with a subscription.', when auth status reports loggedIn false or an authMethod other than 'claude.ai'. The catch block returns that message as reason, so callers never receive this error.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: A rejection from either cliProcess call, such as a spawn failure ('spawn claude ENOENT' when the executable is missing), a non-zero exit ('CLI failed (code): stderr'), a ten-second timeout ('CLI request timed out.'), or output over its limit ('CLI output exceeded its limit.'), is caught and returned as reason, so callers never receive it.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: JSON.parse throws a SyntaxError when the auth status output is not valid JSON. The catch block returns its message as reason, so callers never receive it.
